blueprint_concepts: Divisibility and remainder problems using binomial expansion
english: For a real number $t$, let $\{t\}$ denote the fractional part of $t$. Then the value of $\left\{\dfrac{3^{2026}}{25}\right\}-\left\{\dfrac{7^{2026}}{25}\right\}$ is ______.
hindi: वास्तविक संख्या $t$ के लिए माना $\{t\}$, $t$ का भिन्नात्मक भाग दर्शाता है। तब $\left\{\dfrac{3^{2026}}{25}\right\}-\left\{\dfrac{7^{2026}}{25}\right\}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $3^{2026}=9^{1013}=(10-1)^{1013}$; terms with $10^{2}$ or higher are multiples of $25$: $\equiv-1+1013\cdot10=10129\equiv4\pmod{25}$
solution_full: If $N=25q+s$ with $0\le s<25$, then $\left\{\dfrac{N}{25}\right\}=\dfrac{s}{25}$. So only the remainders modulo $25$ are needed.
originality_note: New: a difference of two fractional parts, each evaluated by a different binomial rewriting ((50-1)^1013 to one term, (10-1)^1013 to two terms), so the result is negative (way 5). Closest known: remainder of 7^n or 3^n on division by 25 or 100. Different because: two remainders with different truncation depth are combined, and the answer is a signed difference.

concept_use.Divisibility and remainder problems usin: Expanding (50-1)^1013 and (10-1)^1013 shows which terms are divisible by 25.
concept_use.Remainder based problems: The remainders 4 and 24 on division by 25 give the fractional parts 4/25 and 24/25.

stem_review: Read as a student: {t} defined, both fractions are of integers by 25, the difference of fractional parts (not the fractional part of the difference) is asked; answer -0.80 is a negative decimal as planned; Hindi mirrors. No change.
key_step: Write 7^2026 = (50-1)^1013 and 3^2026 = (10-1)^1013 and keep the terms that survive modulo 25.
justification: Two routine binomial-remainder computations and a subtraction; several standard steps, no insight. Comparable to 2024-P1-Q8 (L2).
